title: Facta non Verba (Deeds Before Words)
coreMove: Audit sincerity by asking what the person actually does when talk would become expensive.
sourcePressure: Words become weak evidence when action under cost would reveal conviction more reliably.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Reducing the chapter to actions speak louder than words without exposure, sacrifice, or revealed preference.

sourceAnchors.name: Facta non Verba
sourceAnchors.detail: The Latin title and sidecar support action under risk as the evidentiary test of conviction, competence, and loyalty.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The Latin only earns its place if it becomes practical: when words are cheap, the paid action is the evidence.

hook: opening with a tidy definition of skin in the game
starting with a generic meeting room where someone learns accountability
using a macho risk-taking cold open
counterintuition: not just X but Y correction shell
most people think fairness means niceness
the obvious lesson is wrong because the real lesson is deeper
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about risk
write down three ways to be accountable
ask yourself who has skin in the game with no concrete object
examples: generic office meeting with a slide deck
kitchen-table family advice with a mug
abstract consultant conversation with no downside transfer

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: company announcing safety values while rushing an untested release
exampleSpecs.audience: product lead auditing deeds under launch pressure
exampleSpecs.stakes: customers bear the defect if values stay verbal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Chloé blocks release until the safety test appears in the deployment log, not only in the town-hall slide.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red failed-test icon on a deployment board

exampleSpecs.domain: politician praising transit while never riding the failing route
exampleSpecs.stakes: commuters pay for neglect hidden behind speeches
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Niklas asks the candidate to take the 6:40 bus before the endorsement meeting.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: diesel smell at a winter bus shelter

exampleSpecs.domain: nonprofit leader promising transparency but resisting an open ledger
exampleSpecs.audience: board member testing virtue by the paid action
exampleSpecs.stakes: donors and clients need evidence beyond assurances
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Isabel asks which expenses will be visible tomorrow morning and waits for the ledger link.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a board packet clipped with a binder ring

exampleSpecs.domain: parent telling a teenager to value reading while phone-scrolling every evening
exampleSpecs.audience: family member noticing words have no cost
exampleSpecs.stakes: habit evidence teaches more than parental command
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ryan places his phone in another room and reads at the kitchen table before mentioning books again.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a paperback open beside a charging cable

exampleSpecs.domain: manager claiming team health matters while rewarding weekend emails
exampleSpecs.audience: team lead auditing incentives instead of slogans
exampleSpecs.stakes: workers learn from promotion patterns, not wellness language
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Aman rewrites the promotion note that praised weekend availability and names the new evidence standard.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a promotion packet with highlighted email times

exampleSpecs.domain: friend apologizing repeatedly but never changing a recurring imposition
exampleSpecs.audience: reader judging apology through next-cost behavior
exampleSpecs.stakes: trust depends on the paid correction, not the phrase
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Tomasz watches whether the next pickup happens on time before accepting another apology as evidence.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: car keys on a hallway hook
